notes:
Visual semantic indexing prefetches the next keyframe batch while encoding the current one. If a batch contains an unreadable image, it retries the images individually and skips only the unreadable frames.
On Apple Silicon, the multimodal embedding backbone stays on the GPU while the image encoder uses the CPU, so text indexing and search queries no longer fall back to the CPU during visual indexing. Existing visual indexes remain compatible; GPU initialization failures still fall back to the CPU.
Correct DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and Doubao Seed 2.1 Pro/Lite API model IDs so discovery and generation use the same models. If a saved model choice uses an older incorrect ID, reselect the model after updating.
GLM-5.3 and GLM-5.3 Flash support adjustable reasoning levels and their published 1M context and 128K output limits. Low, medium and high map to the provider's low, high and max levels; automatic leaves the provider default. These models always reason, and the output budget includes reasoning tokens.
Space cards and list rows no longer show semantic-index status icons; index status remains available in the item viewer.
Semantic models require macOS Apple Silicon; Windows retains lexical search. Semantic thresholds remain uncalibrated. macOS packages are signed and notarized; Windows CPU, CUDA and Vulkan packages are unsigned and require the Microsoft Visual C++ v14 x64 Redistributable. UI/export, live model/GPU inference and paid agent calls are outside the automated release checks.
